title: Beat the Heat
learning_outcomes: A sensor value crosses a threshold
An actuator changes the next sensor value (feedback)

steps.instruction: Look at the coop temperature on Chicken Tender.

instruction_layers.young: How warm is the chickens' house?
instruction_layers.beginner: Look at the coop temperature on Chicken Tender.
instruction_layers.advanced: Temperature comes from the coop's temperature / humidity sensor (tc/ct_001/sensors, °F, SENSED on a real farm).
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: what temperature feels too hot for you? For a chicken?

steps.instruction: Trigger "Coop too hot": the coop reaches 92°F.

instruction_layers.young: Oh no, it's getting hot! Press the button.
instruction_layers.beginner: Trigger "Coop too hot": the coop reaches 92°F.
instruction_layers.advanced: 92°F crosses the 85°F heat-stress threshold in the heat rule.

steps.instruction: The safe response is to ventilate: turn the fan on and warn the owner.

instruction_layers.young: What cools a hot room? A fan!
instruction_layers.beginner: The safe response is to ventilate: turn the fan on and warn the owner.
instruction_layers.advanced: Actuator: fan relay. Misting or shade need water or other hardware; this rule picks the fan.
instruction_layers.teacher: Let learners suggest other responses and their trade-offs.

steps.instruction: The fan runs and the coop starts to cool.

instruction_layers.beginner: The fan runs and the coop starts to cool.
instruction_layers.advanced: COMMAND_STATE says fan on; only the next SENSED reading shows it worked.
instruction_layers.teacher: Ask: how do we know the fan really worked?

instruction_layers.advanced: Feedback: the new reading closes the loop; the fan stops once it is safely below the threshold.

steps.instruction: Sensor → decision → action → new sensor value.

instruction_layers.beginner: Sensor → decision → action → new sensor value.
instruction_layers.advanced: Closed-loop control: measure, compare with a setpoint, act, measure again.
instruction_layers.teacher: Assessment: the learner draws the loop and labels each part.

steps.instruction: Next: wire a real temperature sensor and send its reading to Tender Cells.

instruction_layers.young: You can build a real temperature sensor!
instruction_layers.beginner: Next: wire a real temperature sensor and send its reading to Tender Cells.
instruction_layers.advanced: Sensors → automation lesson: a DHT22 on a Starter Node publishing tc/{id}/sensors.
instruction_layers.teacher: Bridge to the sensor build lesson.
